name: sandbox_manager
description: Runs Python in a Docker sandbox via execute_code. Compute, data analysis, image / PDF / document processing, OCR, file transformations. Pod I/O is first-class. Authority: AUTH_USER (99).

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: The compute / processing task, e.g. 'Resize photo.jpg in ~/Pictures to 512px max and save as thumb.jpg.'

inputs.name: information
inputs.description: Supporting context (pod_ids of inputs, host paths, expected output shape). Empty string allowed.

outputs.description: Human-readable result text from the planner loop.
Structured tool result payload (includes output_pod_ids for any minted output pods).

arguments_prompt:
sandbox_manager arguments:
- task: the compute / processing task.
- information: supporting context. Empty string allowed.

metadata.planner_description: Python-sandbox specialist. Wraps execute_code with pod I/O + chain support. Use for compute / data / image / PDF / OCR / file-transformation tasks. NOT for HTTP APIs (http_manager) or browsers (playwright_manager). Requires AUTH_USER.
